
## What this document does

`sugar_calibration.Rmd`'s "Cumulative height — nitrogen scenarios vs
observations" plot (`plot-nitrogen-height`) runs with `organ_level_sugar =
TRUE`, which has confirmed, unfixed defects (`sugar_model.cpp`: a broken
`myco_allocation` formula and a circular demand-driven transfer issue) that
collapse the sugar pools - and therefore growth - toward zero within the
first simulated year. That makes the resulting plot show height
*underestimation*, which is really the sugar-model collapse, not a height
growth problem per se.

This notebook copies that same plot structure - same scenarios, same
colours, same real SMEAR observed height/diameter data - but with
`organ_level_sugar = FALSE` (the default, non-organ-level pathway), to see
how the height growth formula itself behaves without that confound. This
pathway doesn't use the enzyme-kinetics sugar sub-model at all, so none of
`sugar_calibration.Rmd`'s calibration/initial-condition setup for that
sub-model is needed here.

```{r libraries}
devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(patchwork)
```

---

## 1  Setup

### 1.1  Parameters

Same `h0`/`D0` overrides as `sugar_calibration.Rmd`'s long-run scenario,
so both notebooks start the simulated tree at the same point (12m height,
matching the real stand's 1998 starting height below).

```{r setup-data}
data_directory  <- "~/Documents/CASSIA_Calibration/Processed_Data/"
loaded_data     <- load_data(data_directory)

new_parameters  <- rep(0.5, 27)
parameters_2015 <- initialize_parameters(calibration = FALSE, new_parameters)

parameters_2015$parameters_test[c("h0"),          "Hyde"] <- 12
parameters_2015$parameters_test[c("D0"),          "Hyde"] <- 0.1646  # back-extrapolated from real "BA weighted mean DBH pine" 2001/2008 (0.1737/0.1950m), the closest real anchor - the old 0.1416 had no documented source and was ~0.023m too low, confirmed via real-vs-simulated slope comparison in manuscript/paper_plan.Rmd Working Notes
parameters_2015$parameters_test[c("GPP_mean"),    "Hyde"] <- 463.8833
parameters_2015$parameters_test[c("GPP_initial"), "Hyde"] <- 460.0
```

### 1.2  Weather data (1998-2022)

```{r setup-weather}
weather_preles <- data.table::fread("~/Documents/CASSIA/data/ERA5_CASSIA_preles.csv")

weather_1998_2022 <- weather_preles[
  weather_preles$date >= as.Date("1998-01-01") &
  weather_preles$date <= as.Date("2022-12-31"), ]
weather_1998_2022$dates <- as.Date(weather_1998_2022$date)

dates_1998_2022 <- weather_1998_2022$dates
```

### 1.3  Observed stand data (SMEAR II)

Real basal-area-weighted mean pine height and diameter at Hyytiälä - field
inventory data, not model output.

```{r load-biomass}
filter_smear <- function(vars) {
  loaded_data$smearII_data[loaded_data$smearII_data$variable %in% vars, ]
}

height_df   <- filter_smear(c("dominant_height",
                              "pine height BA weighted mean",
                              "pine height arithmetic mean",
                              "tree_height_baseal_area_weighted_mean"))
diameter_df <- filter_smear(c("BA weighted mean DBH pine",
                              "Arithmetic mean DBH pine",
                              "pine DBH arithmetic mean",
                              "pine diameter BA weighted mean"))

# Keep only the primary measurement for cleaner scenario plots
height_df   <- height_df[height_df$variable == "tree_height_baseal_area_weighted_mean", ]
diameter_df <- diameter_df[diameter_df$variable == "pine diameter BA weighted mean", ]

obs_height <- data.frame(
  dates = as.Date(paste0(height_df$date, "-12-31")),
  value = height_df$amount
)
obs_diameter <- data.frame(
  dates = as.Date(paste0(diameter_df$date, "-12-31")),
  value = diameter_df$amount / 100  # cm -> m, to match culm_growth_diameter's units
)
```

---

## 2  Baseline run (organ_level_sugar = FALSE)

Single control run on the default (non-organ-level) sugar pathway, used as
the "Simulated" trajectory below. Nitrogen has no effect in this
configuration (see `nitrogen_scenarios.Rmd`), so a single run stands in for
all nitrogen levels here.

```{r run-baseline}
run_nitrogen <- function(nitrogen_balance, nitrogen_change = FALSE,
                         nitrogen_contrast = FALSE) {
  CASSIA_cpp(
    weather                 = weather_1998_2022,
    site                    = "Hyde",
    pPREL                   = c(parameters_2015$pPREL, parameters_2015$N_parameters),
    parameters              = parameters_2015$parameters_test,
    common                  = common_p,
    ratios                  = ratios_p,
    sperling                = parameters_2015$sperling_test,
    needle_mass_in          = 0,
    Throughfall             = parameters_2015$Throughfall,
    photosynthesis_as_input = FALSE,
    nitrogen_balance        = nitrogen_balance,
    nitrogen_change         = nitrogen_change,
    nitrogen_contrast       = nitrogen_contrast,
    preles                  = TRUE,
    fAPAR_Tian              = TRUE,
    organ_level_sugar       = FALSE,
    needle_mass_grows       = TRUE
  )
}

CASSIA_long <- run_nitrogen(25)
```

---

## 3  Publication figure: height and diameter side by side

Clean two-panel layout, consistent styling. Observed SMEAR data
(basal-area-weighted mean, confirmed - not median) are the triangles.

```{r pub-figure, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 5.5}
pub_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey30"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "bottom")

model_col <- "#1b7837"   # dark green: simulated
obs_col   <- "#762a83"   # purple: observed, high contrast against model_col

p_height <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(dates = dates_1998_2022,
                              value = CASSIA_long$Culm_Growth$culm_growth_height),
            aes(x = dates, y = value, colour = "Simulated"), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = transform(obs_height, Scenario = "Observed (SMEAR, BA-weighted mean)"),
             aes(x = dates, y = value, colour = "Observed (SMEAR, BA-weighted mean)"),
             shape = 17, size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = NULL,
                       values = c(Simulated = model_col,
                                  "Observed (SMEAR, BA-weighted mean)" = obs_col)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(12, NA)) +
  labs(title = "Height", subtitle = "organ_level_sugar = FALSE",
       x = NULL, y = "Height (m)") +
  pub_theme

p_diameter <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(dates = dates_1998_2022,
                              value = CASSIA_long$Culm_Growth$culm_growth_diameter),
            aes(x = dates, y = value, colour = "Simulated"), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = transform(obs_diameter, Scenario = "Observed (SMEAR, BA-weighted mean)"),
             aes(x = dates, y = value, colour = "Observed (SMEAR, BA-weighted mean)"),
             shape = 17, size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = NULL,
                       values = c(Simulated = model_col,
                                  "Observed (SMEAR, BA-weighted mean)" = obs_col)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "Diameter", subtitle = "organ_level_sugar = FALSE",
       x = NULL, y = "Diameter (m)") +
  pub_theme

(p_height | p_diameter) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "CASSIA vs. observed Hyytiälä stand growth, 1998–2022",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15))
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
